price_list.read_from_the_page: Claude Sonnet 5.5: Input $2 / MTok, Output $10 / MTok, 5m cache writes $2.50 / MTok, 1h cache writes $4 / MTok, cache hits and refreshes $0.10 / MTok; the full 1M context window at standard pricing
price_list.cache_write_tier: input_cache_write is the 5m write price. Inspect sends the 1h TTL only after a gap of more than 300 seconds between two cached requests of one sample (CACHE_TTL_ESCALATION_GAP in inspect_ai/model/_providers/anthropic.py); an Episode's time limit is 60 seconds, so no Episode reaches it.

tool_calls.replaced_by: one call per turn requested from the provider
tool_calls.why: Inspect has no limit on the number of tool calls (its limits are message, turn, token, time, working time and cost). It is bounded only indirectly: at most one call per model turn if the model makes no parallel tool calls.

b_source: ticket 1b (#234), tests/test_episode_cost_limit.py, B_BYTES: the largest tool message the model is sent, query_readonly 16,525 bytes after Inspect's 16 KiB truncation, against describe_schema 7,002 bytes
framing_allowance_source: the drive's answer C4 on chadlis/hypotrail#232: "The framing allowance is 2,048 tokens, a constant stated in ticket 1b and in the ceiling file"; tests/_cost_ceiling.py, FRAMING_ALLOWANCE_TOKENS

episode_bound.formula: E = C × (1 + p_max/p_in) + [p_max × (1,024 + B + framing allowance) + p_out × 1,024] / 1e6
episode_bound.premise: Every input token is billed at no less than p_in the first time it is sent, since a new tool result cannot be a cache read.
episode_bound.derivation: Inspect checks the cost limit before every provider call and dispatches the call only while the Episode's cost is below C, so the content sent before the last call is under C/p_in tokens. The last call re-sends that content, each token at most at p_max, which costs at most C × p_max/p_in, on top of the C already spent. Its new content is one assistant output of at most 1,024 tokens (the output cap of one call) and, with one tool call per turn, one tool result of at most B bytes, counted at one token per byte, plus the framing allowance, each at most at p_max. Its own output is at most 1,024 tokens at p_out. Summed, one Episode costs at most E.

rerun_rule: A rerun is bounded by the spend recorded so far (the logs' cost at the plan's prices; an Attempt with unknown cost counts at its ceiling) plus this ceiling, at most USD 80 (D-146, B2), not by the lines' ceilings (the drive's answer C1).

conditions_on_c.floor_rule: C is at least twice the dearest kept-log Episode priced with every input token at p_max (D-146, B1; the drive's answer C1)
conditions_on_c.round: a multiple of USD 0.01 (the drive's answer C4)
conditions_on_c.choice: the largest round C whose ceiling at the plan's Repeats is at or under USD 80

repeats_rule.rule: three Repeats when a C that meets the floor gives a three-Repeat ceiling of at most USD 40, else one (D-145, point 6)
